study: Training-noise distribution transfer with frozen PANNs
question: Does recorded-background rather than Gaussian training exposure improve designated-foreground recovery on reserved recorded backgrounds?

representation.scaler: Saved clean-training StandardScaler; float32 transform retained

training.snr_rule: Exact saved per-target, per-variant Gaussian SNR values; originally uniform 10–30 dB
training.assignment_rule: Permute 1200 target indices with default_rng(seed). At shuffled position j, A=j mod6, B=(j+1+(floor(j/6) mod5)) mod6. Separate crop_seed samples uniform valid sample offsets. Two distinct recordings per target; 200 uses per background per variant; 40 uses per ordered distinct background pair.

evaluation.selection: Metadata-based one recording per DEMAND category in each role; all sources/offsets/SNRs fixed before new predictions; no outcome-based screening
evaluation.mixture_rule: Mean-center background; full-window foreground power/added-noise power SNR; float32 additive waveform; no clipping or peak normalization
evaluation.label_semantics: Recover designated original foreground label; backgrounds may contain competing classes; no listening-validated semantic neutrality claim

analysis.primary: recorded_adapted minus gaussian_adapted mean accuracy over all 36 recorded conditions and 398 clips
analysis.weighting: Equal clips and equal environments/windows/SNRs; complete balanced panel required
analysis.bootstrap_unit: 295 foreground src_file groups; all clips and fixed conditions travel together
analysis.interval_scope: Conditional on fixed heads, augmentation realization, background recordings, segments and grid; no environment-population or training-seed uncertainty

budget.stop_rule: Complete one fixed comparison regardless of outcome. Stop for unavailable/invalid required source or failed convergence; no score-driven additional heads, sources, SNRs or fine-tuning.
